root_cause.text: The seg6_input_core() and rpl_input() functions use a NO reference (NOREF) dst obtained from ip6_route_input() without converting it to a refcounted dst before passing it to dst_cache_set_ip6(), allowing a concurrent FIB lookup on a shared nexthop to free the underlying pcpu_rt between the route lookup and the dst_hold() call, resulting in a use-after-free.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description and commit message detail the race sequence where ip6_route_input() sets a NOREF dst (skb_dst_set_noref), and then dst_cache_set_ip6() calls dst_hold() unconditionally on a dst that can be freed by a higher-priority task (due to a generation number bump and a shared nexthop). The patch fixes this by adding skb_dst_force() after ip6_route_input() to obtain a refcounted dst before caching. The diff shows the addition of skb_dst_force(skb) and a NULL check in both seg6_input_core() and rpl_input().
